cards.directive: Review changed behavior before broad maintainability concerns. Separate correctness findings from design suggestions, and tie each finding to code, a trace, or a focused check.

evidence_grade.reason: Project-owned guidance with no claim that it improves outcomes without a controlled comparison.

cards.measurement: Useful when it identifies a changed-behavior defect or removes an unsupported finding.
cards.rationale: A narrow first pass finds consequential defects without spending the review budget on unrelated cleanup.

risks: A narrow review can miss defects outside the declared change.

cards.title: Review the changed behavior first

cards.directive: State the decision, required output, exclusions, and stopping condition before research. Prefer current primary sources and label conclusions that the evidence does not establish.

evidence_grade.reason: Project-owned guidance with no claim that it improves outcomes without a controlled comparison.

cards.measurement: Useful when it defines a missing output, stops unrelated research, or narrows an unsupported claim.
cards.rationale: A decision-shaped research pass limits unrelated browsing and keeps unsupported conclusions out of downstream work.

review.reason: Checked for narrow scope, reversible advice, privacy, and a measurable user outcome.

risks: A stopping condition can be too narrow for the decision.
Primary sources may not support comparative outcome claims.
cards.title: Define the decision before research

cards.directive: Before editing, state observable success checks, explicit boundaries, and the smallest integrated result. Spend planning time on choices that are costly to reverse.

evidence_grade.reason: Project-owned guidance with no claim that it improves outcomes without a controlled comparison.

cards.measurement: Useful when it establishes a missing success check, boundary, or integrated proof before implementation.
cards.rationale: A bounded work packet gives the agent a clear stopping point and tests the main integration path before work expands.

review.reason: Checked for narrow scope, reversible advice, privacy, and a measurable user outcome.

risks: The checkpoint adds overhead to a genuinely mechanical change.
A weak success check can create false confidence.
